in_sanskrit.name: Kishanlal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's grace, Protector
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kishanlal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Kishanlal is derived from Sanskrit, where Kishan means 'God's grace' or 'protector' and Lal means 'beloved'. It is a revered name in Hindu culture, symbolizing the blessings of the gods and the protection of the deities.
